briefdescription.para: NetCDF file input/output routines for canopy model.

detaileddescription.para:
This module contains comprehensive routines for reading and writing NetCDF format files for the canopy model, including meteorological input data and model output data.
S.-B. Kim, T. Otte, T. Spero, P.C. Campbell
Originally 2004, adapted for Canopy-App December 2022
